- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: AD-9 [phase 1/1 review round, 2026-09-30] from `docs/implement-plan/issue-5068-skip-denied-cleanup-calls.md` `## Auto-decisions`: "the pickup whose `Claude issue pickup: hourly` trigger has the latest `created_at` reads the queue; an older one ends its wake without deleting anything, and a wake with no own trigger deletes nothing either (the check now comes before the deletes)." Per the PR description's "Twin-first" paragraph and the changelog's "Flows covered" row, this AD-9 fix is part of the §26.I work delivered by this PR.
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md — step 1 `— wake.` section (around line 39) and the "One pickup, never deeper." Rules bullet (around line 84)
  Evidence of absence: The diff for `.claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md` includes only the §26.I cleanup-call annotations (4 hunks at lines 38-44, 66-72, 75-81, 83-89). The AD-9 race-condition fix strings are not in the file: "end the turn, deleting nothing", "If one bound to another session has a later `created_at` than yours, a newer pickup replaced you", "report `claude-issue-pickup: not the active pickup (newer trigger <id> → session <persistent_session_id>)`", "The pickup left behind reads no queue item, so no target gets two sessions", and "only the pickup whose trigger has the latest `created_at` reads the queue". The pickup file has no `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md` twin (per AD-7), so the implementation must come from a `[claude-twin-sync]` commit on this branch — but no such commit is present (the last twin-sync commit `6d973f2` covers only `implement-plan-claude.md`). `tests/test_implement_issue_claude_command.py::test_pickup_skips_a_denied_cleanup_call` (added in the last commit `7575c79`) asserts every one of these strings. At runtime, the first assertion `wake.index("end the turn, deleting nothing") < wake.index("Otherwise delete every enabled")` raises `ValueError` because the substring is absent, failing the test and breaking CI. The PR description acknowledges this is "pending in the fourth sync", and the progress log records Status: BLOCKED, but the failing test and missing pickup-file hunks remain in this PR's diff.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
